aum.raw: over JPY 85 billion total under management (projected with SIF4, 2026)

strategy.thesis: Sony Group's corporate venture capital, established 2016, investing across stages in B2C/B2B startups in deep tech, entertainment tech, enterprise tech, fintech/DLT and climate tech via multiple funds, run by a ~30-person global team.

summary.en: Sony Group's corporate venture capital (operating as Sony Ventures), established 2016. It runs multiple funds (Sony Innovation Fund I–IV, Innovation Growth Fund, Environment and Africa funds) with total AUM projected to exceed JPY 85 billion once SIF4 (2026) closes at JPY 20 billion+. A ~30-person global team invests in deep tech, entertainment tech, enterprise tech, fintech and climate tech.
summary.local: ソニーグループのCVC(ソニーベンチャーズ)。2016年設立。複数ファンドを運営し、SIF4(2026年・200億円超)完了後の運用総額は850億円超の見込み。約30名のグローバルチーム。
